canonical_source.behavior: Advance the onboarding wizard only after validating the current step: required site name plus HTTP/HTTPS URL on step 1, then required WordPress username plus Application Password length >= 8 on step 2. No persistence or external call occurs during NextAsync.

laravel_adaptation.flow: Three-step React onboarding wizard. Continue validates only the active step, keeps the user on the current step on failure, advances exactly one step on success, and reaches a read-only review step before the pre-existing Save/Test/Sync operation.
laravel_adaptation.authorization: Control renders only when authoritative FrontendContext permissions contain sites.manage (or *).
laravel_adaptation.secret_handling: Application Password is rendered only as a password input during step 2 and is masked in the review step; NextAsync never transmits it.

security_boundary.authentication: Inherited from the authenticated tenant React bootstrap.
security_boundary.tenant_context: Uses the server-authored FrontendContext for the active tenant; NextAsync accepts no tenant or object identifier.
security_boundary.permission: sites.manage gates the entire onboarding control.
security_boundary.csrf: not applicable because NextAsync performs no HTTP request
security_boundary.secret_non_exposure: The secret is not rendered in review text and is not sent until the separate Save/Test/Sync operation.
security_boundary.truthful_success: No success message or server state is claimed by Continue; it only changes local wizard step state.
